title: Classification of irreducible real modules of real Lie superalgebras
summary: We classify irreducible finite-dimensional modules of a collection of real Lie superalgebras that includes the simple ones, their classical variants, complex Lie superalgebras after restriction of scalars, and all real Lie algebras. Our strategy is to reduce this classification to determining the orbits of the parity and conjugation functors on irreducible modules of the complexifications of the aforementioned algebras.
